title: Assert unread wake metadata after relay boot recovery and an older receipt ACK
outcome: The production-shape boot recovery test detects an unread second boundary being presented as an acknowledged continuation, including after replaying an older receipt.
acceptance: The existing boot recovery test asserts the queued mailbox source unread_count is one after rearm and after the old first receipt ACK, while retaining the second message identity and sequence.
The assertions check structured observable wake state without sleeps, timeout inflation or instruction/Markdown phrase pins; applicable focused tests and required review/gate evidence are recorded.
